_comment: Copy to the channel repo as tts-ledger.json. Append one entry immediately after QA, with result and rms_qa recorded. Committed as text. Local-only: bin/tts_budget.py log refuses any engine outside the local suite.

moss-sfx-v2.route: ~/.local/bin/moss-sfx-v2 (48 kHz stereo, <=30 s, cinematic sound design)

sa3-sfx.route: ~/.local/bin/sa3-sfx (44.1 kHz stereo, ~14 s per 4 s take, rapid/mechanical UI)

moss-transcribe.route: ~/.local/bin/moss-transcribe (0.9B ASR + diarization; .ass/.srt, 10 ms timestamps; duration verification)

kokoro.route: legacy scratch: <path to your kokoro render_narration.py> (bm_george, 24 kHz mono); new projects scratch with moss-nano-tts
